_comment: SEEDED $translate crosswalks (data-is-not-code). Representative cross-map pairs the demo pipeline uses: ICD-10-CM <-> CMS-HCC and SNOMED-CT <-> ICD-10-CM. Each crosswalk declares its asset id + version (ILLUSTRATIVE STUB, NOT the full licensed ConceptMap / CMS mapping) so a translated target carries WHICH crosswalk (and which version) produced it. A source code with no entry returns NO-MAP; a target is NEVER fabricated. Live ConceptMap $translate against a real terminology server is the not-configured production path (fail-closed via the terminology seam).

E11.9.display: Diabetes with glycemic, unspecified, or no complications

I50.9.display: Heart failure, except end-stage and severe

N18.6.display: Chronic kidney disease, stage 5, or end-stage renal disease
